messages:
jess: Quick update from the SlateBridge health audit 1: they're seeing p95 spikes ~180-260ms during peak and the renewal NPS is trending down if latency doesn't improve :frowning:
ryan: Oof. Do we know whether it's model compute or queuing?
nina: Traces show KV cache miss rate high on session continuations and a lot of requests hitting the 30B fp16 endpoint. No quantization in prod.
jess: Customer is cost-sensitive. My recommendation: run a 2-week canary with an int8 variant plus a compact fallback route for non-priority traffic.
matt: Agree. Canary plan: 3% traffic to int8 (dedicated pool), 5% to 7B compact hosted fallback for bursts. We'll monitor quality and latency.
ryan: Routing policy I propose: route_by_tag -> dedicated-us-west for priority flags -> if queue depth>10 or timeout -> fallback to hosted-compact-7b. Keep per-route timeout 2.2s.
nina: Notes for ML: int8 build needs kernel tune on attention for seq_len=1536; also will run regen-quality eval vs baseline on their prompt corpus.
jess: Can you prepare the eval set + A/B script? CS needs token-cost delta and fidelity metrics for the account deck.
nina: Putting together eval. Example canary config snippet: ```
{ "canary": { "percent": 3 }, "models": [ { "name": "slatebridge-30b-int8", "route": "dedicated-usw" }, { "name": "slatebridge-7b-compact", "route": "hosted-fallback" } ] }
```
ryan: Operational checklist: enable KV-prefetch on canary nodes, pre-warm cache, set circuit-breaker to failover after 1 retry, and auto-scale min=2 instances. Ill add to deploy playbook.
matt: CS will want cost ballpark: nina, any estimates?
nina: Rough: int8 ~30-40% token cost reduction vs fp16. 7B compact ~65-75% on fallback traffic. Latency: int8 might add ~10-25ms compute for short seqs but reduces queue-induced tail.
jess: Good. I'll draft enablement playbook and schedule a 20-min handoff with SlateBridge next Wed 10am PT. Also ask devs to log prompt_id and eval_id on any regression to auto-flag in console.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-8602 for canary and link ML-EVAL-621.
jess: Thanks team 1 tagging @nina @ryan @matt. Nina, can you drop the eval artifacts and checklist by EOD? Aim to propose canary window Thu 8-10am PT.
nina: Yep, will post checklist + eval links by EOD.
jess: This should help stabilize p95 and give SlateBridge a clear cost/quality tradeoff before renewal. :slightly_smiling_face:
